entities.name: 6G system
entities.description: A system aimed at supporting new and enhanced services and scenarios based on IMT-2030 usage scenarios.
entities.evidence: The present document aims to identify high level principles and use cases - to define potential requirements to enable the 6G system to support the needs of new and enhanced services and scenarios, based on, but not limited to, IMT-2030 usage scenarios.
